description: For the fixed fresh-constant language inclusion \(j:L\hookrightarrow L(d)\), every matrix theory \(T_\Gamma\) has a nonempty model exactly when the theory of translated universal closures \(T_{j\Gamma}\) does.
signature:

  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Matrix L)) :
  (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.universalTheory Γ).IsSatisfiable ↔
    (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.universalTheory
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.mapMatrix
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.freshInclusion L) ''
          Γ)).IsSatisfiable
